from web import customer_heading
cases = [('Lee', 'Lee'), ('  Ada   Lovelace  ', 'Ada Lovelace'), ('\\tAda\\nLovelace\\r', 'Ada Lovelace'), ('', 'Anonymous'), (' \\t\\n ', 'Anonymous'), ('\\u2003Ada\\u00a0Lovelace\\u2003', 'Ada Lovelace')]
